name: libur-nasional
description: Indonesian public holidays (libur nasional) and cuti bersama, 2011 to next year: list, check a date, upcoming holidays, working-day counts (no API key, cached)

nodes.title: List holidays
nodes.description: Indonesian national holidays (libur nasional) and cuti bersama of a year (2011 to next year), optionally one month or kind; each item has date, name, is_national_holiday and kind

year.description: Year (default: the current year in Asia/Jakarta)

kind.description: all, libur_nasional (national holidays) or cuti_bersama (collective leave)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Check a date
nodes.description: Whether a date (default: today in Asia/Jakarta) is a national holiday, cuti bersama, weekend or working day, with the holiday names

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Upcoming holidays
nodes.description: The next national holidays (and cuti bersama) from a date, across the year boundary, with how many days away each is

from_date.description: YYYY-MM-DD to start from, included (default: today in Asia/Jakarta)

include_cuti_bersama.description: Also list cuti bersama (collective leave) days

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: Count working days
nodes.description: Working days (Monday-Friday minus national holidays and, by default, cuti bersama) between two dates, both included; at most 3 calendar years

cuti_bersama_is_day_off.description: Count cuti bersama as days off (true for civil servants; many private employers follow it)

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none

nodes.title: API Hari Libur request
nodes.description: Call any API Hari Libur endpoint that has no dedicated operation, e.g. path "/api/today". Only the API's own host is allowed.

path.description: Path relative to the API base, starting with "/", e.g. "/api/today"

outputs.name: next_cursor
outputs.description: Cursor for the next page, empty when there is none
